name: foss-design
description: Design canvases and design systems on your machine: live, animated, clickable screens on an infinite canvas, kept in a gitignored .design folder and previewed locally. Two skills: designing-canvases and building-design-systems.

interface.longDescription: Design UI as real, live screens: React or HTML pages with animations, forms and navigation, laid out on an infinite canvas with pages, notes and a play mode. Keep the design system (tokens, components with live specimens, guidelines, assets) next to them in a gitignored .design folder, check every screen in Chrome, screenshot it for review, and preview everything in a local viewer. No accounts, no uploads, no size limits.
defaultPrompt: Design the onboarding flow for this app on a canvas.
Extract this project's design system into .design/system.
Show me three directions for the pricing page.
